title: Noisy metadata triage journal
content:
Purpose: quick personal journal for recurring metadata/noise patterns seen in user-provided records + candidate heuristics to clean/flag for labelers. Not final — tests and small scripts will validate. Top recurring noise buckets (observed Nov 2024 -> Jan 2025): 1) Timestamp weirdness - epoch-ish integers pasted into text fields (e.g. \"1633024800\") — often from client export. - mixed timezone suffixes: \"2023-08-12T14:23\" vs \"2023-08-12 14:23:00 UTC+2\" - partial dates (\"2021-05\") — treat as lower-precision timestamp. Heuristic proposals: * try parse ISO first, fallback epoch-int -> if parsed as epoch but appears inside free-text, mark field \"likely-epoch-noise\". * convert partial dates to 1st-of-month and tag precision=month. 2) Embedded HTML/markup fragments in text fields - examples: \"
Confirmed
\", leftover \" \" or inline \"
\" markers. - sometimes entire JSON/HTML blob stored in summary field. Actionable steps: * strip basic tags via whitelist, but store original hash for audit. * if >30% non-alnum chars after stripping, flag as noisy-html-blob. 3) Identifier collisions and pseudo-ids - short numeric ids (e.g. \"12345\") reused across customers -> not globally unique. - client-side composite ids: \"acct-42::session-7\" vs. plain \"42\". Label guidance: * avoid assuming numeric string = canonical id; prefer context (field name + provenance header). * If id looks autogenerated (uuid pattern) but is short, mark: \"suspect-truncated-uuid\". 4) Email-like tokens in natural text vs. canonical email field - labelers often see names with embedded emails: \"Contact: john.doe (john@example.com)\". - For PII masking tasks, need consistent rule: prefer canonical email field; if none and pattern exists, treat as extracted email but include evidence snippet. 5) Language-mismatched punctuation and invisible characters - zero-width no-break spaces, weird Unicode hyphens, nonbreaking spaces cause tokenization drift. - Quick script: normalize NFKC, collapse whitespace to single space, remove zero-width markers. Labeling heuristics and examples (for handoff to labelers): - TASK: \"intent\" (support triage) — primary rule: base label on explicit action verbs adjacent to user mention. If verb absent, use \"ambiguous_intent\". Examples: 1) \"Can you reset my password?\" => intent: reset_password (clear) 2) \"Password not working — help\" => intent: reset_password (infer) 3) \"My account 12345 keeps failing\" => intent: account_issue (if more context absent), but add evidence: id_present. 4) \"Hello\" or \"FYI: attached\" => ambiguous_intent. - TASK: \"span extraction\" for product mentions — guideline: prefer canonical product tokens (product names list in confluence) over generic terms. If matched to multiple product names, choose longest-match. If still ambiguous, mark \"multi-match\" and include candidate list in annotations.
